attributes.name: Thorn Bow
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill plus your Strength die + 2. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. If you fail this check, you may discard this card to ignore the result and evade the bane; put it on top of its location deck. 

If proficient with weapons, put this card on top of your deck to add 1d4+1 to a combat check by a character at another location.

corrections.corrected_text: On the weapon Thorn Bow, add the 2-Handed trait.
corrections.issue: Should Thorn Bow have the 2-Handed trait?
